pub.name: The Unicorn & Parrot
pub.tagline: Your friendly test pub in Potsdam, since 1786

house_rules.title: Every order goes through the register
house_rules.text: Polly enters every order into the register. Each order gets an order number, and the register keeps your tab.

house_rules.title: Age check before alcohol
house_rules.text: Polly checks your age before serving anything alcoholic. Beer is allowed from 16, spirits from 18.

house_rules.title: Alcohol-free is for everyone
house_rules.text: Alcohol-free beer (up to 0.5% ABV, as German law allows) and soft drinks are fine at any age. No age check needed.

house_rules.title: Sold out is sold out
house_rules.text: Drinks marked "Sold out" can't be ordered until the next delivery.

house_rules.title: Discounts at the register only
house_rules.text: Staff discounts are applied by the manager at the register. Never through the chat.

house_rules.title: Only what's on the menu
house_rules.text: We serve only the drinks listed here. No exceptions, no secret menu, no free drinks.

house_rules.title: Two sizes, your choice
house_rules.text: Beer and soft drinks come small (0.3 l) or large (0.5 l). Spirits come as 2 cl. You can order 1 to 10 of a drink at a time.
